name: sweep
description: See and clean the storage Claude Code leaves behind: agent and workflow worktrees with their node_modules, temp scratchpads, superseded plugin versions, old transcripts, checkpoints, old CLI binaries and stray config copies. Every view is a fresh scan; sweep stores nothing. Dry run by default; never touches unsaved work.

chartStyle.title: Chart style
chartStyle.description: auto: pictures in kitty and Ghostty, block and braille characters elsewhere. pixels: always pictures. cells: always characters.
